description.zh:
Bucket权限类型：
private：私有（默认值）
public-read-write：公共读写
public-read：公共读
description.en: Bucket permission type: private (default). public-read-write: Allows public read and write access. public-read: Allows public read access.

description.zh:
Bucket名称。
3~50 个字符，只允许小写字母、数字、短横线（-），且不能以短横线开头或结尾。
description.en: Bucket name. Must be 3 to 50 characters long. Use only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (-). Cannot start or end with a hyphen.

description.zh: 备注。长度为0-128个字符、汉字或表情符等。
description.en: Comment. Up to 128 characters, including letters, digits, Chinese characters, and emojis.

description.zh:
调度范围，取值范围：
- domestic（国内）
- oversea（海外）

> 当创建全局bucket时该参数必须指定。
description.en:
Scheduling scope. Valid values:

- domestic (within China)

- outside China

> You must specify this parameter when creating a global bucket.

description.zh: 节点区域id，不指定时为全局默认节点
description.en: Edge zone ID. If not specified, the global default edge zone is used.

description.zh:
逻辑bucket类型，取值范围：
sink: 下沉（指定节点）
standard：标准(全局)（默认值）
description.en: The logical type of the bucket. Valid values: sink: A sink bucket on a specified node. standard: A standard global bucket. This is the default value.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens put-bucket --bucket-name my-bucket --logical-bucket-type sink --comment this_is_comment --bucket-acl private --ens-region-id xx-xx-xx --dispatch-scope sink --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens PutBucket --region cn-hangzhou --LogicalBucketType sink --Comment this_is_comment --BucketAcl private --BucketName 'my-bucket' --DispatchScope sink --EnsRegionId 'xx-xx-xx'
